newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebecor Printing extends Maclean contract.
newsitem.headline: Quebecor Printing extends Maclean contract.

text.p: Quebecor Printing Inc said on Monday that it agreed with Maclean Hunter Publishing Ltd to extend its printing contract for Maclean Hunter's portfolio of consumer and business publications to the year 2005.

Under the contract, whose renewal was effective January 1, 1997, Quebecor Printing will print more than 500 million magazines for Maclean Hunter, which is a wholly owned unit of Rogers Communications Inc.

The magazines include Canadian news magazine Maclean's, fashion magazines Chatelaine and Flare and French-language news magazine L'Actualite. Maclean Hunter also publishes more than 40 business and professional publications.
Quebecor Printing's original five-year contract with Maclean Hunter began in 1995.
